4 Days Lake Nakuru Maasai Mara Safari

Package overview

This 4-day safari takes you from the scenic Great Rift Valley to the world-famous Masai Mara. Begin with the iconic pink flocks of flamingos and rhinos of Lake Nakuru National Park, then continue to Masai Mara—Kenya’s most celebrated reserve, home to the Big Five and breathtaking savannah landscapes. Enjoy extraordinary game drives, comfortable accommodations, and expert guiding throughout your wildlife adventure.

  • Lake Nakuru
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Lake Nakuru National Park is Kenya's first government-protected rhino sanctuary and a major highlight. It hosts one of the largest concentrations of the critically endangered Eastern black rhino and a thriving population of Southern white rhino
  • Rare Rothschild's Giraffe: The park is a sanctuary for the endangered Rothschild's giraffe, which was translocated here for its protection.
  • The Big Five (minus one): The park is home to four of the "Big Five" game animals: lions, leopards, rhinos, and buffaloes. Elephants are not present due to the park's perimeter fencing.
  • Makalia Falls : Located in the southern part of the park, these picturesque seasonal waterfalls offer a tranquil setting for picnics and birdwatching, especially after the rains.
  • Masai Mara
  • The Great Migration (Seasonal): If traveling between July and October, witness the epic river crossings of millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Mara River.
  • Big Cat Sightings: The Mara is renowned for guaranteed sightings of lions, cheetahs, and leopards—it is one of the best places in the world to see predators in action.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi – Lake Nakuru National Park

Begin your journey with a scenic drive down the Great Rift Valley escarpment with a brief photo stop. Continue to Lake Nakuru National Park , known for its alkaline lake, spectacular birdlife, and black & white rhinos. Activities: Arrive at Lake Nakuru in time for lunch. Afternoon game drive exploring the diverse wildlife including rhinos, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, and sometimes lions & leopards. Visit the shores of the lake for birdwatching—pelicans, flamingos, herons, and more. Dinner & Overnight: Lodge or Camp in Lake Nakuru area

02Day 2 | Lake Nakuru – Masai Mara National Reserve

After breakfast, depart for the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve , arriving in time for lunch. Freshen up and prepare for your first thrilling game drive in the Mara. Activities: Afternoon game drive in search of the Big Five, big cats, elephants, giraffes, and vast herds of plains game. Enjoy the golden savannah landscapes and sunset views. Dinner & Overnight: Lodge or Camp in Masai Mara

03Day 3 | Full Day in Masai Mara

Spend the entire day exploring the Masai Mara, Kenya’s premier wildlife destination. The reserve offers unmatched wildlife density and dramatic safari encounters. Activities: Full-day game drive with packed lunch (or morning & afternoon game drives). Track lions, cheetahs, elephants, buffalos, zebras, and hippos along the Mara River. Optional: Visit a Maasai village (extra cost). Dinner & Overnight: Lodge or Camp in Masai Mara

04Day 4 | Masai Mara – Nairobi

Enjoy a relaxed early morning game drive before breakfast. Depart the Masai Mara with scenic views as you return to Nairobi, marking the end of your unforgettable safari with Magical Africa Safaris. Activities: Sunrise game drive Return drive to Nairobi Drop off at your hotel or airport Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
